primary_rule_source.owner: Blueprint Fund Management, TFPN sponsor; identifies Jerry Parker as portfolio manager and Chesapeake as sub-adviser

cards.source_exact: The issuer describes several exponential moving-average and breakout parameters spanning 50 to 200 days. Positions receive stop losses and position/sector/portfolio risk limits.

performance_evidence.description: Public ETF record beginning 2023-07-11, with issuer-published NAV/price return tables and annual financial-statement links; not an independently verified private-account record or proof of one exit component.
performance_evidence.limitation: This agent did not independently reconcile NAV history or inspect the linked auditor opinion. Grade B is public traceability, not a claim that the displayed returns were audited in this task.

cards.source_exact_vs_operationalization: No executable ZEL rule is proposed: the source does not specify which single lookback, indicator, stop distance, or exit condition to select.
cards.excluded_reason: Choosing an endpoint of a 50-200-day range or attributing another Turtle author's 10/20-day rule to Parker would add unsupported specificity.
cards.duplicate_parent: Broad cut-loss/let-profit-run principle overlaps parent; exact mechanism comparison unavailable.

primary_rule_source.owner: Technical Analysis of Stocks & Commodities interview, hosted by Tom Basso's official website and linked from his Research page
primary_rule_source.title: The Traders' Psyche: Tom Basso

cards.source_exact: Basso recommends building a simple five-day and ten-day moving-average system as a starting example. He separately describes reducing exposure when volatility rises and reports a profitable silver trade entered around 5 dollars in 1987.

performance_evidence.description: First-person claim of profit on an earlier silver trade in this same primary interview; concrete educational rule periods are supplied.
performance_evidence.limitation: AUM, Market Wizards recognition, and long career are not treated as audited performance. The profitable trade is not evidence that this MA example caused the profit.

source_supplied: Educational example rather than a disclosed deployed system
zel_operationalization: Completed UTC days assembled from six contiguous 4h bars
Long runner bearish state is SMA5 < SMA10; equality does not trigger
Apply only after actual parent profit partial execution
Replace the parent's daily close<SMA10 runner trend exit with this one MA-state exit
Act only at next observable open and retain native floor, parent break-even exit and data-safety priority
not_claimed: A source-specified cryptocurrency session or fill model

inputs: This campaign's actual partial-fill and remaining-quantity state
implementation_spec.activation: Only after this campaign's parent profit partial has actually filled
implementation_spec.rule: On each completed UTC day with at least 10 complete daily closes, if arithmetic mean(last5 closes) < arithmetic mean(last10 closes), schedule this lot's residual exit at next actual open.
implementation_spec.boundary: If no next open exists before the existing terminal boundary, retain the terminal marked remainder with costs; do not create a fill.
preserved: Original reg71 signals and entry sizing
Native hard floor and data safety
Actual released-capacity reuse and independent new campaigns

cards.duplicate_parent_reason: Parent tests current completed daily close against SMA10; this component tests the five-day average against SMA10. Some paths may coincide but the rule is distinct.
cards.causal_design: PASS_DESIGN_ONLY; implementation and synthetic verification remain root-owned
cards.screen_authorized_by_this_card: Root must accept educational-example fidelity and Grade C limitation before Stage1 freeze.
